boss_predict.py.src:
from contextlib import contextmanager

class ShopError(Exception):
    pass

@contextmanager
def till():
    print("till open")
    try:
        yield
    except ShopError as e:
        print("refund:", e)
    finally:
        print("till closed")

with till():
    print("sell tea")
with till():
    raise ShopError("no milk")
print("end of day")

class Silencer:
    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        if exc_type is ZeroDivisionError:
            print("silenced:", exc)
            return True     # handled: carry on
        return False        # anything else keeps ringing

with Silencer():
    print(1 / 0)
print("after the first with")

with Silencer():
    print(int("x"))
print("never printed")
